commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Jesus Gil Manzano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Substitution. Moussa Diakite (Cadiz) has come on for Ruben Alcaraz.
90+3' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+3' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz).
90+3' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+2' Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
90+2' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replacing Jorgen Strand Larsen.
90+2' Substitution. Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Luca de la Torre walks off.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Celta Vigo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

87' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
86' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but David Gil is equal to it and makes an easy save.
84' The referee awards a corner and Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) goes over to take it.

83' What a great touch by Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.
81' That's the end of the game for Manu Sanchez, who is replaced by Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) replaces Chris Ramos.
77' Sergio has decided to make a change. Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) replaces Ruben Sobrino.
77' The game has come to an end for Ivan Alejo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lucas Pires (Cadiz).

75' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
74' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

72' This was a piece of cake for David Gil. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
71' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
71' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
67' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
67' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
63' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
60' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes it short.

60' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes behind for a corner. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Manu Sanchez plays it into the box, and Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
54' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Carl Starfelt is replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
54' The referee signals a substitution. Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Kevin Vazquez.
53' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
50' The corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by David Gil.

50' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
49' The attendance is 17302.
48' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' The corner is swung in and Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
45+4' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

45+4' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
45+3' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+3' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' David Gil (Cadiz) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

45+1' What a great effort! Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
44' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

40' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the right side of the goal, but it lacks power and David Gil pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
39' Sergio has decided to make a change due to the red card. Mamadou Mbaye is brought on as a substitute for Roger Marti (Cadiz).
38' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
37' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
36' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.

36' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is going to have a crack himself.
35' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Victor Chust (Cadiz): it’s upheld, he has to go!

34' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Victor Chust (Cadiz), but referee Jesus Gil Manzano must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
33' The referee interrupts the game and gives a red card to Victor Chust (Cadiz). He can take an early bath.
31' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
29' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
29' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
26' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
24' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
24' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
24' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
21' It's like he was asking for a caution. Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) receives a yellow card.
21' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared David Gil (Cadiz).

20' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top right corner, but David Gil was alert and the score remains the same. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
20' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) picks up a long through ball, but Vicente Guaita deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

16' 0 - 1 Ivan Alejo showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Chris Ramos (Cadiz) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 0:1.
16' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
15' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
9' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
9' The foul by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) was seen by Jesus Gil Manzano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo in a dangerous position.
8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Roger Marti (Cadiz).
6' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Roger Marti (Cadiz) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
1' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but David Gil comes off the line to clear the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
